rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claims 8 and 9: the prototype wins by default over what the real services do today, and a DR1 judgement on the same difference overrides it; here both agree, since the prototype sends both links to the overall dashboard and DR1 (Rhys, 2026-08-28) ruled the dashboard moves to trade-imports-ins-frontend, so the animals frontend's /live-animals link is overruled.
outcome: 'Return to your dashboard' on the confirmation page and a viewed notification's Back link both go to the overall dashboard, which is the INS front door's dashboard (trade-imports-ins-frontend), reached through its configured URL on the workspace stack and in CDP. The prototype sends both links to the overall dashboard (prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-101, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-159) and DR1 already ruled the dashboard moves to the INS front door (document-dr1-parity-notes-p1-014), so today's link to the animals frontend's /live-animals list changes. Where the animals frontend runs without an INS front-door URL configured, the link falls back to /live-animals.
